project.title: dxtr_box
project.tagline: A local-first data layer for Flutter with a Rust-backed core.

summary.short: dxtr_box is a custom local data layer focused on fast Flutter access, a Rust-backed storage core, and a Flutter-friendly API.
summary.long: Current work includes performance hardening, cross-frontend validation, benchmark evidence, and a roadmap toward a Firestore-like fluent query API while keeping the core frontend-neutral.
